# Default values for cue.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

replicaCount: 1

sealedSecrets:
  enabled: false

image:
  registry: docker.io
  repository: cue
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
  tag: "latest"

# Global image settings for all services
global:
  imageRegistry: ""
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Backend services common configuration
backend:
  replicaCount: 1
  imageTag: latest
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
  env: {}

# List of backend services
backendServices:
  - name: auth-service
    port: 8080
  - name: user-service
    port: 8080
  - name: profile-service
    port: 8080
  - name: discovery-service
    port: 8080
  - name: booking-service
    port: 8080
  - name: payment-service
    port: 8080
  - name: chat-service
    port: 8080
  - name: notification-service
    port: 8080
  - name: review-service
    port: 8080
  - name: support-service
    port: 8080
  - name: analytics-service
    port: 8080
  - name: api-gateway
    port: 8080

# Frontend configuration
frontend:
  imageTag: latest
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m

# Infrastructure services
postgres:
  imageTag: "15.19"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
  persistence:
    enabled: false
    # existingVolumeName:
    accessMode: ReadWriteOnce
    size: 10Gi

rabbitmq:
  imageTag: "3-management"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
  # Additional configuration
  vhost: "/"
  management:
    enabled: true
    plugin: rabbitmq_management
  # Persistence (optional - enable if needed)
  persistence:
    enabled: false
    storageClass: ""
    accessMode: ReadWriteOnce
    size: 10Gi

redis:
  imageTag: "7-alpine"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

jaeger:
  imageTag: "1.47"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 1Gi
      cpu: 500m
    requests:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 250m

# Secret values (to be set by the user, preferably via --set-file or --set-string)
# RAW secrets (no base64 required)
# Example: echo -n "your-value" | base64
secret:
  # PostgreSQL credentials
  POSTGRES_USER: admin
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: localsecret
  POSTGRES_DB: cue_db

  # RabbitMQ credentials
  RABBITMQ_USER: admin
  RABBITMQ_PASSWORD: localsecret

  # Redis password
  REDIS_PASSWORD: localsecret

  # Stripe API key for payments
  STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: sk_test_421ffVAem5k5Ea8 # placeholder

  # JWT signing key for authentication tokens
  JWT_SIGNING_KEY: supersecretjwtskieforlocal # placeholder

  # Auth Service specific secrets
  JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES: "15"
  JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS: "7"

  # Database connection strings
  AUTH_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  # Auth Service DB connection string
  USER_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  # User Service DB connection string
  BOOKING_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  # Booking Service DB connection string
  PAYMENT_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  # Payment Service DB connection string
  # Connection string for AuthService (used by Entity Framework Core)
  ConnectionStrings__CueDatabase: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret

  # Email service credentials (if using external email provider)
  EMAIL_API_KEY: c2vjcmV0 # placeholder
  EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS: cue@mailcompany.com

  # Redis connection strings
  REDIS_CONNECTION_STRING: redis://redis:6379

# Example of how to generate base64 values:
# Linux/macOS:  echo -n "your-value" | base64
# Windows PS:   [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("your-value"))

# Ingress configuration

  enabled: false
  className: ""
  annotations: {}
    # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx

    - host: chart-example.local

# Service configuration for all services (if needed)

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq
  labels:
    {{- include "cue.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "cue.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "cue.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: rabbitmq
          image: "rabbitmq:{{ .Values.rabbitmq.imageTag | default "3-management" }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.global.imagePullPolicy | default "IfNotPresent" }}
          ports:
            - name: amqp
              containerPort: 5672
              protocol: TCP
            - name: http
              containerPort: 15672
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-backend-secret
                  key: RABBITMQ_USER
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-backend-secret
                  key: RABBITMQ_PASSWORD
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST
              value: "{{ .Values.rabbitmq.vhost }}"
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - check_running
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - check_local_alarms
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.rabbitmq.resources | nindent 12 }}
          {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: rabbitmq-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/rabbitmq
          {{- end }}
      {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}
      volumes:
        - name: rabbitmq-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq-pvc
      {{- end }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq-service
  labels:
    {{- include "cue.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type | default "ClusterIP" }}
  ports:
    - port: 5672
      targetPort: 5672
      protocol: TCP
      name: amqp
    - port: 15672
      targetPort: 15672
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
  selector:
    {{- include "cue.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
{{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "cue.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq-pvc
  labels:
    {{- include "cue.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
spec:
  accessModes:
    - {{ .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.accessMode }}
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.size }}
  {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.storageClass }}
  storageClassName: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.storageClass }}
  {{- end }}
{{- end }}

# Local deployment values for cue-platform Helm chart
# For deployment on a local k3s/minikube cluster

# Global image settings
global:
  imageRegistry: ""
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Backend services configuration
backend:
  replicaCount: 1
  imageTag: latest
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Frontend configuration
frontend:
  imageTag: latest
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

# PostgreSQL configuration
postgres:
  imageTag: 15-3.4
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    accessMode: ReadWriteOnce
    size: 5Gi

# RabbitMQ configuration
rabbitmq:
  imageTag: "3-management"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m
  # Additional configuration
  vhost: "/"
  management:
    enabled: true
    plugin: rabbitmq_management
  # Persistence (optional - enable if needed)
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    storageClass: ""
    accessMode: ReadWriteOnce
    size: 5Gi

# Redis configuration
redis:
  imageTag: "7-alpine"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m
    requests:
      memory: 64Mi
      cpu: 50m

# Jaeger configuration (distributed tracing)
jaeger:
  imageTag: "1.47"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Secrets configuration - Plain text values (will be base64 encoded by Helm chart)
secret:
  # PostgreSQL credentials
  POSTGRES_USER: admin
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: localsecret
  POSTGRES_DB: cue_db

  # RabbitMQ credentials
  RABBITMQ_USER: admin
  RABBITMQ_PASSWORD: localsecret

  # Redis password
  REDIS_PASSWORD: localsecret

  # Stripe API key for payments (use test key for local)
  STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: sk_test_421ffVAem5k5Ea8 # placeholder

  # JWT signing key for authentication tokens
  JWT_SIGNING_KEY: supersecretjwtskieforlocalhev

  # Auth Service specific secrets
  JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES: "15" # Access token expiry in minutes
  JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS: "7" # Refresh token expiry in days

  # Database connection strings (will be generated from postgres service)
  AUTH_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  USER_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  BOOKING_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  PAYMENT_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  ConnectionStrings__CueDatabase: Host=cue-cue-postgres-service;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret

  # Email service credentials
  EMAIL_API_KEY: local # placeholder
  EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS: cue@localhost.local

  # Redis connection strings
  REDIS_CONNECTION_STRING: redis://redis:6379

  # RabbitMQ connection
  RABBITMQ_CONNECTION_STRING: amqp://admin:localsecret@rabbitmq:5672

  # Jaeger tracing endpoint
  JAEGER_AGENT_HOST: jaeger-agent-split-jeager:6831

# Ingress configuration for local development
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
  hosts:
    - host: cue.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
        - path: /api
          pathType: Prefix
  tls: []

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-postgres
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.postgres.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgis/postgis:{{ .Values.postgres.imageTag }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.global.imagePullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          volumeMounts:
            - name: postgres-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.resources | nindent 12 }}
      volumes:
        - name: postgres-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-postgres-pvc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-postgres
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
spec:
  selector:
    {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
  type: {{ .Values.service.type | default "ClusterIP" }}
---
{{- if .Values.postgres.persistence.enabled }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-postgres-pvc
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
spec:
  accessModes:
    - {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.accessMode }}
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.size }}
{{- end }}

# Local deployment values for cue-services Helm chart
# For deployment on a local k3s/minikube cluster

# Enable infrastructure dependency (set to true to deploy infrastructure alongside)
infrastructure:
  enabled: false

# Global image settings
global:
  imageRegistry: ""
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Backend services configuration
backend:
  replicaCount: 1
  imageTag: latest
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Frontend configuration
frontend:
  imageTag: latest
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Jaeger configuration (distributed tracing)
jaeger:
  imageTag: "1.47"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Secrets configuration - Plain text values (will be base64 encoded by Helm chart)
secret:
  # Stripe API key for payments (use test key for local)
  STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: sk_test_421ffVAem5k5Ea8 # placeholder

  # JWT signing key for authentication tokens
  JWT_SIGNING_KEY: supersecretjwtskieforlocalhev

  # Auth Service specific secrets
  JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES: "15" # Access token expiry in minutes
  JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS: "7" # Refresh token expiry in days

  # Database connection strings (pointing to infrastructure services)
  AUTH_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  USER_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  BOOKING_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  PAYMENT_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  ConnectionStrings__CueDatabase: Host=cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret

  # Email service credentials
  EMAIL_API_KEY: local # placeholder
  EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS: cue@localhost.local

  # Redis connection strings (point to infrastructure Redis)
  REDIS_CONNECTION_STRING: redis://cue-cue-infrastructure-redis:6379

  # RabbitMQ connection (point to infrastructure RabbitMQ)
  RABBITMQ_CONNECTION_STRING: amqp://admin:localsecret@cue-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq:5672

  # Jaeger tracing endpoint
  JAEGER_AGENT_HOST: jaeger-agent-split-jeager:6831

# Ingress configuration for local development
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
  hosts:
    - host: cue.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
        - path: /api
          pathType: Prefix
  tls: []

# Cue Platform - Separated Helm Charts

This repository contains two separate Helm charts for deploying the Cue platform:

## 1. Infrastructure Chart (`helm-chart-infrastructure`)

**Purpose**: Deploys stable infrastructure components that don't need frequent updates.

**Components**:
- **PostgreSQL** (postgis/postgis) - Database with persistence
- **RabbitMQ** (rabbitmq:3-management) - Message queue with management UI
- **Redis** (redis:7-alpine) - Cache
- **PgAdmin** (dpage/pgadmin4) - Database administration UI

**When to deploy**: 
- Initial cluster setup
- Infrastructure version upgrades (rare)
- Disaster recovery

**Deployment**:
```bash
# Install infrastructure
helm install cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace

# Upgrade infrastructure (rare)
helm upgrade cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values-local.yaml -n cue
```

**Access**:
- PostgreSQL: `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres:5432`
- RabbitMQ: `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq:5672` (AMQP), `:15672` (Management UI)
- Redis: `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-redis:6379`
- PgAdmin: NodePort 30001 (http://localhost:30001)

---

## 2. Services Chart (`helm-chart-services`)

**Purpose**: Deploys microservices and frontend that are under active development and need frequent deployments.

**Components**:
- **12 Backend Microservices**: auth-service, user-service, profile-service, discovery-service, booking-service, payment-service, chat-service, notification-service, review-service, support-service, analytics-service, api-gateway
- **Frontend** (React/Next.js)
- **Jaeger** (Distributed tracing)

**When to deploy**:
- Every code change (CI/CD pipeline)
- Feature deployments
- Bug fixes
- Canary/blue-green deployments

**Deployment**:
```bash
# Install services (assumes infrastructure already deployed)
helm install cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace

# Upgrade specific service (via image tag)
helm upgrade cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml \
  --set backendServices[0].imageTag=v1.2.3 \
  -n cue

# Upgrade all services with new image tag
helm upgrade cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml \
  --set backend.imageTag=v1.2.3 \
  -n cue

# Deploy only frontend
helm upgrade cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml \
  --set frontend.imageTag=v1.2.3 \
  -n cue
```

---

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Kubernetes Cluster                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌──────────────────────────┐  ┌────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  cue-infra (namespace)   │  │  cue-services (ns)     │   │
│  │  ┌────────────────────┐  │  │  ┌──────────────────┐  │   │
│  │  │ PostgreSQL         │  │  │  │ auth-service     │  │   │
│  │  │ RabbitMQ           │  │  │  │ user-service     │  │   │
│  │  │ Redis              │  │  │  │ profile-service  │  │   │
│  │  │ PgAdmin            │  │  │  │ ... (12 total)   │  │   │
│  │  └────────────────────┘  │  │  │ frontend         │  │   │
│  │         ▲                │  │  │ Jaeger           │  │   │
│  │         │ DNS            │  │  └──────────────────┘  │   │
│  │         │                │  │         ▲              │   │
│  └─────────┼────────────────┘  └─────────┼──────────────┘   │
│            │                              │                  │
│            │   Service Discovery          │                  │
│            │   (ClusterIP Services)       │                  │
│            └──────────────────────────────┘                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Service Discovery

Services in `cue-services` namespace connect to infrastructure via Kubernetes DNS:

| Infrastructure | DNS Name | Port |
|----------------|----------|------|
| PostgreSQL | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 5432 |
| RabbitMQ | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 5672 |
| RabbitMQ Management | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 15672 |
| Redis | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-redis.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 6379 |

> **Note**: The `values-local.yaml` in services chart uses short names (e.g., `cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres`) assuming both charts deployed to same namespace. For cross-namespace, use FQDN format above.

---

## CI/CD Integration

### GitHub Actions Example

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy-infrastructure.yml
name: Deploy Infrastructure
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'helm-chart-infrastructure/**'
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/k8s-set-context@v1
        with:
          kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}
      - run: helm upgrade --install cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values.yaml -n cue-infra --create-namespace
```

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy-services.yml
name: Deploy Services
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'backend/**'
      - 'frontend/**'
      - 'helm-chart-services/**'
      - '!helm-chart-infrastructure/**'
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/k8s-set-context@v1
        with:
          kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}
      - run: |
          IMAGE_TAG=${{ github.sha }}
          helm upgrade --install cue-services ./helm-chart-services \
            -f ./helm-chart-services/values.yaml \
            --set backend.imageTag=$IMAGE_TAG \
            --set frontend.imageTag=$IMAGE_TAG \
            -n cue --create-namespace
```

---

## Benefits of Separation

| Aspect | Before (Single Chart) | After (Separated) |
|--------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **Infrastructure updates** | Risk of restarting services | Independent, safe upgrades |
| **Service deployments** | Full chart reinstall | Fast, targeted deployments |
| **Rollback** | Everything rolls back | Rollback only services |
| **CI/CD** | Single pipeline | Separate pipelines, different triggers |
| **Team ownership** | Shared | Infra team owns infra, App team owns services |
| **Testing** | Full stack test | Unit test services, integration test infra |

---

## Migration from Single Chart

If migrating from the original `helm-chart`:

1. Deploy infrastructure first:
   ```bash
   helm install cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace
   ```

2. Verify infrastructure is healthy:
   ```bash
   kubectl get pods -n cue -l app.kubernetes.io/instance=cue-infra
   ```

3. Deploy services:
   ```bash
   helm install cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace
   ```

4. Verify services connect to infrastructure:
   ```bash
   kubectl logs -n cue deployment/cue-services-auth-service
   ```

5. Delete old chart:
   ```bash
   helm uninstall cue -n cue
   ```

```bash
  --set frontend.imageTag=v1.2.3 \
  -n cue
```

---

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Kubernetes Cluster                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌──────────────────────────┐  ┌────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  cue-infra (namespace)   │  │  cue-services (ns)     │   │
│  │  ┌────────────────────┐  │  │  ┌──────────────────┐  │   │
│  │  │ PostgreSQL         │  │  │  │ auth-service     │  │   │
│  │  │ RabbitMQ           │  │  │  │ user-service     │  │   │
│  │  │ Redis              │  │  │  │ profile-service  │  │   │
│  │  │ PgAdmin            │  │  │  │ ... (12 total)   │  │   │
│  │  └────────────────────┘  │  │  │ frontend         │  │   │
│  │         ▲                │  │  │ Jaeger           │  │   │
│  │         │ DNS            │  │  └──────────────────┘  │   │
│  │         │                │  │         ▲              │   │
│  └─────────┼────────────────┘  └─────────┼──────────────┘   │
│            │                              │                  │
│            │   Service Discovery          │                  │
│            │   (ClusterIP Services)       │                  │
│            └──────────────────────────────┘                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Service Discovery

Services in `cue-services` namespace connect to infrastructure via Kubernetes DNS:

| Infrastructure | DNS Name | Port |
|----------------|----------|------|
| PostgreSQL | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 5432 |
| RabbitMQ | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 5672 |
| RabbitMQ Management | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 15672 |
| Redis | `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-redis.cue-infra.svc.cluster.local` | 6379 |

> **Note**: The `values-local.yaml` in services chart uses short names (e.g., `cue-cue-infrastructure-postgres`) assuming both charts deployed to same namespace. For cross-namespace, use FQDN format above.

---

## CI/CD Integration

### GitHub Actions Example

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy-infrastructure.yml
name: Deploy Infrastructure
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'helm-chart-infrastructure/**'
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/k8s-set-context@v1
        with:
          kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}
      - run: helm upgrade --install cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values.yaml -n cue-infra --create-namespace
```

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy-services.yml
name: Deploy Services
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'backend/**'
      - 'frontend/**'
      - 'helm-chart-services/**'
      - '!helm-chart-infrastructure/**'
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/k8s-set-context@v1
        with:
          kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}
      - run: |
          IMAGE_TAG=${{ github.sha }}
          helm upgrade --install cue-services ./helm-chart-services \
            -f ./helm-chart-services/values.yaml \
            --set backend.imageTag=$IMAGE_TAG \
            --set frontend.imageTag=$IMAGE_TAG \
            -n cue --create-namespace
```

---

## Benefits of Separation

| Aspect | Before (Single Chart) | After (Separated) |
|--------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **Infrastructure updates** | Risk of restarting services | Independent, safe upgrades |
| **Service deployments** | Full chart reinstall | Fast, targeted deployments |
| **Rollback** | Everything rolls back | Rollback only services |
| **CI/CD** | Single pipeline | Separate pipelines, different triggers |
| **Team ownership** | Shared | Infra team owns infra, App team owns services |
| **Testing** | Full stack test | Unit test services, integration test infra |

---

## Migration from Single Chart

If migrating from the original `helm-chart`:

1. Deploy infrastructure first:
   ```bash
   helm install cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace
   ```

2. Verify infrastructure is healthy:
   ```bash
   kubectl get pods -n cue -l app.kubernetes.io/instance=cue-infra
   ```

3. Deploy services:
   ```bash
   helm install cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace
   ```

4. Verify services connect to infrastructure:
   ```bash
   kubectl logs -n cue deployment/cue-services-auth-service
   ```

5. Delete old chart:
   ```bash
   helm uninstall cue -n cue
   ```

I've successfully separated the Helm charts into two distinct charts:

## Summary

### 1. **Infrastructure Chart** (`helm-chart-infrastructure/`)
Contains stable components that rarely change:
- **PostgreSQL** (postgis/postgis) - with PVC persistence
- **RabbitMQ** (rabbitmq:3-management) - with management UI and optional persistence
- **Redis** (redis:7-alpine) - cache
- **PgAdmin** (dpage/pgadmin4) - database admin UI on NodePort 30001

### 2. **Services Chart** (`helm-chart-services/`)
Contains frequently deployed microservices:
- **12 Backend Services**: auth-service, user-service, profile-service, discovery-service, booking-service, payment-service, chat-service, notification-service, review-service, support-service, analytics-service, api-gateway
- **Frontend** (React/Next.js)
- **Jaeger** (distributed tracing)
- Depends on infrastructure chart as optional dependency

### Key Benefits
| Aspect | Improvement |
|--------|-------------|
| **Deployment speed** | Services deploy in seconds without touching infrastructure |
| **Safety** | Infrastructure upgrades won't restart services |
| **CI/CD** | Separate pipelines with different triggers |
| **Rollback** | Rollback services independently |
| **Team ownership** | Infra team manages infra, app team manages services |

### Deployment Commands
```bash
# Deploy infrastructure (once, rarely updated)
helm install cue-infra ./helm-chart-infrastructure -f ./helm-chart-infrastructure/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace

# Deploy services (frequent, on every code change)
helm install cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml -n cue --create-namespace

# Quick service update (e.g., new image tag)
helm upgrade cue-services ./helm-chart-services -f ./helm-chart-services/values-local.yaml --set backend.imageTag=v1.2.3 -n cue
```

Both charts pass `helm lint` and `helm template` rendering tests. I've also created a detailed `README-HELM.md` with architecture diagrams, service discovery details, and CI/CD examples.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    app.kubernetes.io/component: message-queue
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: rabbitmq
          image: "rabbitmq:{{ .Values.rabbitmq.imageTag | default "3-management" }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.global.imagePullPolicy | default "IfNotPresent" }}
          ports:
            - name: amqp
              containerPort: 5672
              protocol: TCP
            - name: http
              containerPort: 15672
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: RABBITMQ_USER
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: RABBITMQ_PASSWORD
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST
              value: "{{ .Values.rabbitmq.vhost }}"
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - check_running
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - check_local_alarms
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.rabbitmq.resources | nindent 12 }}
          {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: rabbitmq-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/rabbitmq
          {{- end }}
      {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}
      volumes:
        - name: rabbitmq-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq-pvc
      {{- end }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type | default "ClusterIP" }}
  ports:
    - port: 5672
      targetPort: 5672
      protocol: TCP
      name: amqp
    - port: 15672
      targetPort: 15672
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
  selector:
    {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
{{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq-pvc
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
spec:
  accessModes:
    - {{ .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.accessMode }}
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.size }}
  {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.storageClass }}
  storageClassName: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.storageClass }}
  {{- end }}
{{- end }}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq
  labels:
    {{- include "infrastructure.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    app.kubernetes.io/component: message-queue

  replicas: {{ .Values.rabbitmq.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "infrastructure.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: rabbitmq
          image: "rabbitmq:{{ .Values.rabbitmq.imageTag | default "3-management" }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.global.imagePullPolicy | default "IfNotPresent" }}
          ports:
            - name: amqp
              containerPort: 5672
              protocol: TCP
            - name: http
              containerPort: 15672
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: RABBITMQ_USER
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: RABBITMQ_PASSWORD
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST
              value: "{{ .Values.rabbitmq.vhost }}"
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - check_running
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 6
            successThreshold: 1
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:

            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 6
            successThreshold: 1
          startupProbe:
            exec:

            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 10

          resources:

      {{- if .Values.rabbitmq.persistence.enabled }}

            claimName: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-rabbitmq-pvc
      {{- end }}

All infrastructure pods are now ready. The issue was that the `rabbitmq-diagnostics` commands were taking too long to execute (more than 1 second default timeout), causing the liveness and readiness probes to fail and restart the pod in a loop.

I fixed it by:
1. Increasing `timeoutSeconds` from default 1s to 10s/15s/30s for different probes
2. Adding a `startupProbe` with generous timeouts (initialDelay: 30s, timeout: 30s, failureThreshold: 60 = 15 minutes max)
3. Increasing `initialDelaySeconds` for liveness/readiness probes to give RabbitMQ more time to fully boot
4. Increasing `failureThreshold` to allow more failures before restarting

Now all infrastructure components are healthy and ready.

content.text:
All infrastructure pods are now **healthy and ready**:

| Pod | Status | Ready |
|-----|--------|-------|
| `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres` | Running | 1/1 |
| `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq` | Running | 1/1 |
| `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-redis` | Running | 1/1 |
| `cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-pg-admin` | Running | 1/1 |

## Root Cause

The `rabbitmq-diagnostics` commands were taking **longer than the default 1-second probe timeout** to execute, causing:
- Readiness probes to fail → pod marked Not Ready
- Liveness probes to fail → pod killed and restarted
- **CrashLoopBackOff** cycle

## Fix Applied

Updated `helm-chart-infrastructure/templates/rabbitmq-deployment.yaml` with proper probe configurations:

```yaml
startupProbe:
  exec:
    command: [rabbitmq-diagnostics, check_running]
  initialDelaySeconds: 30     # Wait 30s before first check
  periodSeconds: 15           # Check every 15s
  timeoutSeconds: 30          # Allow 30s for command to complete
  failureThreshold: 60        #60 × 15s = 15 minutes max startup time

livenessProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 120    # Give RabbitMQ 2 minutes to fully boot
  periodSeconds: 30
  timeoutSeconds: 30
  failureThreshold: 6

readinessProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  periodSeconds: 15
  timeoutSeconds: 15
  failureThreshold: 10
```

The key changes:
- **`timeoutSeconds: 30`** - Allows `rabbitmq-diagnostics` enough time to run
- **`startupProbe`** - Prevents liveness probe from killing container during slow startup
- **Longer `initialDelaySeconds`** - Gives RabbitMQ time to complete its boot sequence (which takes ~60-100s with persistent volumes)

# For deployment on a local k3s/minikube cluster

# Enable infrastructure dependency (set to true to deploy infrastructure alongside)
infrastructure:
  enabled: false

# Global image settings
global:
  imageRegistry: ""
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# Backend services configuration
backend:
  replicaCount: 1
  imageTag: latest
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Frontend configuration
frontend:
  imageTag: latest
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 128Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Jaeger configuration (distributed tracing)
jaeger:
  imageTag: "1.47"
  replicaCount: 1
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
      cpu: 250m
    requests:
      memory: 256Mi
      cpu: 100m

# Secrets configuration - Plain text values (will be base64 encoded by Helm chart)
secret:
  # Stripe API key for payments (use test key for local)
  STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: sk_test_421ffVAem5k5Ea8 # placeholder

  # JWT signing key for authentication tokens
  JWT_SIGNING_KEY: supersecretjwtskieforlocalhev

  # Auth Service specific secrets
  JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES: "15" # Access token expiry in minutes
  JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS: "7" # Refresh token expiry in days

  # Database connection strings (pointing to infrastructure services)
  AUTH_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue.svc.cluster.local;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  USER_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue.svc.cluster.local;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  BOOKING_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue.svc.cluster.local;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  PAYMENT_DB_CONNECTION: Host=cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue.svc.cluster.local;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret
  ConnectionStrings__CueDatabase: Host=cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-postgres.cue.svc.cluster.local;Port=5432;Database=cue_db;Username=admin;Password=localsecret

  # Email service credentials
  EMAIL_API_KEY: local # placeholder
  EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS: cue@localhost.local

  # Redis connection strings (point to infrastructure Redis)
  REDIS_CONNECTION_STRING: redis://cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-redis.cue.svc.cluster.local:6379

  # RabbitMQ connection (point to infrastructure RabbitMQ)
  RABBITMQ_CONNECTION_STRING: amqp://admin:localsecret@cue-infra-cue-infrastructure-rabbitmq.cue.svc.cluster.local:5672

  # Jaeger tracing endpoint
  JAEGER_AGENT_HOST: jaeger-agent-split-jeager:6831

# Ingress configuration for local development
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
  hosts:
    - host: cue.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
        - path: /api
          pathType: Prefix
  tls: []

kind: Deployment

  template:
    metadata:

        app.kubernetes.io/name: rabbitmq
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: rabbitmq
          image: "rabbitmq:{{ .Values.rabbitmq.imageTag | default "3-management" }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.global.imagePullPolicy | default "IfNotPresent" }}
          ports:
            - name: amqp
              containerPort: 5672
              protocol: TCP
            - name: http
              containerPort: 15672
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "infrastructure.fullname" . }}-secrets
                  key: RABBITMQ_USER
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:

                  key: RABBITMQ_PASSWORD
            - name: RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST

          livenessProbe:

                - check_running
            initialDelaySeconds: 120
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 6
            successThreshold: 1
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - check_local_alarms
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 15
            failureThreshold: 10
            successThreshold: 1
          startupProbe:

            timeoutSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 60

          resources:

            - name: rabbitmq-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/rabbitmq
